product.name: Fresh Poultry

product.name: Frozen Poultry
product.description: Frozen chicken products including whole chickens and various cuts, preserved for extended shelf life and flexible use.

product.name: Added Value Poultry Products
product.description: Ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat poultry products such as marinated, breaded, cooked, and portioned chicken items for food service and retail.

product.name: Deli Meats
product.description: Fully cooked and ready-to-eat meat products including beef, chicken, and turkey varieties for sandwiches, salads, and snacks.

product.name: Livestock and Animal Health Products
product.description: Production and distribution of animal feed, day-old broiler chicks, hatching eggs, veterinary medicines, livestock equipment, and related technology.
